title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（杉本康弘研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Sugimoto Yasuhiro)
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. (2) Learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed for that purpose. (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme (especially, related to Fluid dynamics), which was determined during in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

In executing the project, it is necessary to make full use of digital technology based on actual issues and data from various regions (companies).

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.

Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the your project and the advancement
process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content.
(3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board.
(3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary. (The numbers in the text correspond to those of the student's action goals.)

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals:

Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models.
Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions using the obtained results.

In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme (especially, related to Fluid dynamics), which was determined during in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.)
Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process.

In executing the project, it is necessary to make full use of digital technology based on actual issues and data from various regions (companies).
